pack: Bundle the module graph rooted at `url`, which must be a WHATWG `URL` instance. `readModule` is called with a `URL` instance for every module to be read and must either return the module source, if it exists, or `null`. `listPrefix` is called with a `URL` instance of every prefix to be listed and must yield `URL` instances that have the specified `URL` as a prefix. If not provided, prefixes won't be bundled. `writeFile` is called for every addon or asset that should be offloaded rather than embedded; see the [Offloading section of the README](https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-pack#offloading). When `writeFile` is provided, `listPrefix` must be passed positionally (or as `null`).
PackOptions:
`concurrency`, `base`, and `offload` belong to `bare-pack`. The other options come from the
[`TraverseOptions`](/bare/reference/bare/modules/bare-module-traverse) of `bare-module-traverse`,
which `bare-pack` depends on at `~2.7.0` since v2.2.5. Version 2.7 of `bare-module-traverse` added
`mount`, and added the `bare-module-resolve` options `defer`, `deferredProtocol`, `directories`,
`engines`, and `imports` to the type.

When the entry is itself a bundle, `mount` is the URL it is mounted at, and the addons and assets
that it declares resolve against `mount` instead of the entry's URL. A bundle that the graph
imports, such as `require('./bar.bundle')`, adds the addons and assets that it declares to
`bundle.addons` and `bundle.assets`, resolved against its own URL. Both come from
`bare-module-traverse` 2.7.1.
ReadModuleCallback: Called with a `URL` for every module in the graph; returns the module source as a `Buffer` or string, or `null` if it does not exist. It may return a promise.
ListPrefixCallback: Called with a `URL` for every prefix to list; yields the `URL`s that have it as a prefix. It may be an async generator.
ResolveModuleCallback: Called with the `URL` of each resolved module, addon, and asset; returns the `URL` to use in its place. The bundle stores the module under the returned `URL`, and the imports that resolved to `url` point to it. Added in v3.0.0. See [Symlinks](#symlinks).
WriteFileCallback: Called for each addon or asset to offload rather than embed, receiving the file `URL` and its source. It may return a promise. If it returns a string, that string replaces the file's resolution in the bundle's imports map and in `bundle.addons` or `bundle.assets`; otherwise, when `base` is set, the resolution defaults to `'/../' + <path-relative-to-base>`, which resolves to a sibling of the bundle. See [Offloading](#offloading).
